reduction.scope: All feasible declared discrete schedules preserved. No infeasible-state energy preservation is claimed.

raw_qubo.proof: If feasible, nonnegative objective <=B and P=B+1 force every ground state to satisfy all one-hot, resource, precedence and makespan constraints.

master.scope: Exact objective/constraints over two supplied complete trajectories per order; all other raw schedules excluded. Classical parent generation is a substantive cost; no lossless global compression claim.

quantum_runs.scope: Exact restriction of full planning-window QUBO. Unrestricted X mixer; best OBSERVED energy with classical postselection. Exact control reference never supplies QAOA/uniform output. All classical conditioning/statevector/angle work retained.
